newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Heidemij and DHV end merger talks.
newsitem.headline: Heidemij and DHV end merger talks.

text.p: Dutch engineering consultancy Heidemij NV said on Monday it had ended merger talks with fellow Dutch engineering consultancy DHV Beheer BV.
Heidemij said both companies had decided that the integration process would have been much more complex than had been expected when the merger plan was announced in October.

Heidemij had said in October it planned to place 5.25 million new shares with the foundation which controls unlisted DHV to effect a merger which would have created an engineering consultancy with annual sales of over 1.4 billion guilders.
